name: team-classic
title: Team Classic Grid
description: A pink team page with a script-like heading and four member cards: square photos, names, green role labels and three small social icons each.
use: A small startup team page wants a soft, friendly roster with social links.
avoid: Each photo needs a square crop, and the four members are hardcoded in the JSX.
a11y: Social icon links have no text or aria-label, so they read as unnamed links. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A pale pink page with a centred heading and two lines of tiny grey copy. Four cards show a rounded square portrait with a soft shadow, a bold name, a small green uppercase role and three grey social icons in a row.
behaves: Hovering a card adds a coloured ring around the photo and pops a small emoji badge into the top corner. The social icons darken on hover.
customise: Names, roles, photos, ring colours and emojis are literal objects in the file; spacing and the pink background are classes.
weight: light: Four small portraits and a scroll reveal; hover effects are CSS.
demo: Candice Wu, Demi Wilkinson, Drew Cano and Natali Craig with their roles.
issues: Social icon links carry no accessible names.
The intro paragraph is filler copy that says nothing about the team.
polishWhy: Pleasant pink palette and clean portraits; filler copy and bare social icons hold it back.
